teachBack.purpose: Sigil is a Forsetti Pattern B multi-module single application: RFSigilUIModule carries the Phase 1 dashboard UI and seven app-owned service modules (APS gateway, Aeostara gateway, visible glyph, source authority, pipeline placeholder, privacy/security, diagnostics) run alongside it. ForsettiCore provides module registry, manifest validation, capability-scoped service lookup, entitlement-aware activation, and runtime composition; SigilRuntimeAssembly composes the runtime and feeds the dashboard through app-owned status providers.
teachBack.nonPurpose: Forsetti does not provide ASH Pattern System semantics, Aeostara base semantics, numerology or glyph mathematics, personal-data processing, or any backend or network service. Sigil does not extend Forsetti internals for product behavior; the framework is a sealed runtime consumed through public products and contracts only. Field note: product.baselineCommit identifies the Sigil repository baseline for this record and is intentionally distinct from system.sourceCommit, which is the authority-container revision.
teachBack.productLocalImplementation: SigilModuleCatalog defines the eight product-owned module definitions (ModuleDescriptor plus in-code ModuleManifest objects at manifest template 1.1 plus module factories); SigilModuleRegistryInstaller.registerAll(into:) registers them into a ForsettiCore ModuleRegistry; SigilRuntimeAssembly and SigilRuntimeFactory compose the Forsetti runtime; each RFSigil* service target implements its ForsettiModule with app-owned gateway/service code. Manifests are constructed in product code through the public ForsettiCore API; no manifest JSON resources are shipped in the product bundle today.
teachBack.permittedExternalDependencies: ForsettiCore only, from the Forsetti-Framework-Mac-iOS Swift package at a pinned revision. Live product pin: 43eef7a739f3b78253c64aa4b070521ab5b1f43c (0.1.4 per Package.resolved). The dependencyAllowlist contains exactly one entry (ForsettiCore). ForsettiPlatform and ForsettiHostTemplate are allowed public products under the profile but are not consumed by Sigil today and are not allowlist entries in this contract.
teachBack.externalOnlyMaterials: Everything inside the Forsetti repository stays upstream: Sources/ForsettiCore, Sources/ForsettiPlatform, Sources/ForsettiHostTemplate, the internal ForsettiModulesExample target, XcodeTemplates, Scripts, workflows, and governance material. Sigil references the upstream repository by pinned commit and reads it for conformance; it never copies, vendors, forks, or patches it.
teachBack.templateAndExampleUse: The Forsetti Xcode templates informed the app-owned scaffolding shape (bootstrap file, module registry file, module class plus view, manifest conventions) that Sigil realized in its own targets. ForsettiModulesExample is evaluation-only material and is never consumed as a product dependency. No template or sample code is copied into Sigil, and sample identities (template placeholder tokens, example product identifiers) must not appear in product files.
teachBack.conformanceProof: Product tests (ForsettiModuleRegistrationTests, DashboardStatusTests, IntegrationGatewayTests) assert the registered entry points, catalog and manifest alignment, and runtime assembly composition; scripts/verify-sigil-guardrails.sh runs the strict guardrails validator, swift test, and xcodebuild -list; the realization validator contract, preflight, and delivery modes against this contract verify the dependency allowlist, prohibited-acquisition rules, and product-owned realization presence.

composition.pattern: Forsetti deployment Pattern B (multi-module single application): exactly one dedicated UI module (RFSigilUIModule) plus seven app-owned service modules, composed by product code; local-only operation with no backend.

composition.dependencyDirection: UI and service modules depend on RFSigilCoreModels and ForsettiCore only; RFSigilForsettiModules depends on every service module and the UI module; RFSigilRuntime composes the catalog, services, and ForsettiCore. No service module imports the UI module.
composition.registrationAndDiscovery: SigilModuleCatalog.definitions is the single source of the eight module definitions; SigilModuleRegistryInstaller.registerAll(into:) registers the factories; discovery and activation use the public ForsettiCore runtime flow.
composition.communication: Framework-mediated: ForsettiModuleContext services and published module events; dashboard data flows through app-owned status providers into RFSigilRuntimeAssembly.dashboardStatus().
composition.lifecycle: Each module implements idempotent ForsettiModule start/stop; the runtime is built per launch by SigilRuntimeFactory.makeRuntime(); dashboard status is a synchronous app-owned read.
composition.persistence: Local-only in Phase 1; no backend persistence; diagnostics remain local under RFSigilDiagnostics ownership.
composition.capabilities: Minimal per module: the UI module requests view injection; privacy/security requests the security capability with default role security; diagnostics requests the diagnostics capability plus one required emit I/O requirement; the remaining service modules request no capabilities.
composition.runtimeRequirements: iOS 17 minimum per Package.swift; ForsettiCore manifest floor 0.1.4 (live product pin 0.1.4, contract profile authority 0.1.5); no entitlement-gated paid modules (no iapProductID declared).
